answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 78 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a velvet bet on surviving 78 epochs of grading, and every garden settlement recomputes the wharf schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 10 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 33 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
